items.prompt: Do closed intervals [1,4] and [5,6] become one interval here?

options.text: Yes, because 4 and 5 are adjacent integer labels.
options.why: Their real-valued time windows have a gap between 4 and 5.

options.text: Yes, because all closed intervals merge.
No, they share no time point.
options.why: The rule merges equal endpoints, not arbitrary integer adjacency.

options.text: No, because intervals sharing equal endpoints never merge.
options.why: That reason is false: equal closed endpoints do merge.
